message.content: {"count":2,"rationale":"Deploy mfa:admin and mfa:dbadmin. mfa:admin blocks authentication to both DC and ADFS, so admin_dc and admin_adfs remain false. mfa:dbadmin then blocks authentication to the database, fileserver, and backup, preventing every exfiltration technique even if CI leaks database-admin credentials. No single control suffices: mfa:admin alone leaves the CI credential-leak route open; mfa:dbadmin alone can be bypassed through DC or ADFS administration; segmented alone can be bypassed by escalating a phished workstation or laptop; and any single patch or mfa:user leaves a phishing-to-internal-access-to-DC attack route available."}
